g.text: TO: exceeded 4 h; broken columns are symbolic, not measured heights. RSS strips share one scale; hollow dots show v2 main-process RSS only.
Time includes preparation. Historical runs and v2 reruns differ in cache state and epoch count; v2 Ratebeer is capped. No total-process-tree memory claim.
